deathScreen.jaymospowers.waiting: Someone may yet reach you. %s seconds left.
limbo.jaymospowers.title: You are in Limbo
limbo.jaymospowers.line: Watch over your body. Your friends may bury you, or a druid may give you another.
limbo.jaymospowers.leave: Hold %s to give it up and reincarnate
message.jaymospowers.limbo.reborn: You wake in another body. Your name and your memories are yours still; the old body's gifts are not.
message.jaymospowers.limbo.no_spirit: No one is waiting in the dark for this body.
